Student Portal

📊 Student Portal Workflow

🎬 Student Portal Overview

📸 Step-by-Step Demo

Real screenshots captured while logged in as Student Portal

1

Login URL: /login

🔗 View Live

Student logs in at system.sclsandbox.xyz with their email and password. The system detects the STUDENT role and redirects to the Student Portal.

2

Student Dashboard URL: /student/portal

🔗 View Live

The main portal home shows enrolled courses, upcoming assessments, notifications, and a progress summary. Student can see their full academic overview at a glance.

3

Grades & Progress URL: /student/grades

🔗 View Live

The Grades page shows a detailed breakdown of all module scores. Sarah has earned 311.7/400 points (78% overall progress) across all her courses.

4

Assessments URL: /student/assessments

🔗 View Live

View all upcoming and past assessments — assignments, quizzes, and submissions — with due dates, status, and feedback from teachers.

5

My Profile URL: /student/profile

🔗 View Live

Students can view and update their personal details — name, contact, address, nationality, visa status, emergency contacts, and programme details.

Overview of admissions pipeline, student counts, application statistics, and quick-action buttons for common tasks.

Login URL: /login

The faculty dashboard shows a summary of assigned courses, recent student activity, assessment counts, and quick-access links.

Course-level activity breakdown — total assignments (3), quizzes (2), forums (2), resources (1), links (1). Summary shows 10 total modules per course.

Track all 55 courses through their lifecycle stages — from creation to archival. View status, enrolment counts, and manage course progression.
